scripts.build: pnpm run build-resume-html && pnpm run build-resume-pdf
scripts.build-resume-pdf: mkdir -p dist; pnpm exec resume export --theme ./resume/ --resume ./resume/resume.yaml ./dist/resume.pdf
scripts.build-resume-html: mkdir -p dist; pnpm exec resume export --theme ./resume/ --resume ./resume/resume.yaml ./dist/resume.html
